scope: Resolve a native VARCHAR whose stock utf8mb4_bin collation is fixed by a single declared table default or an explicit compatible column override.
structure: The completed value contains the resolved character capacity, nullability and effective builtin collation at its exact physical slot. The table and column options belong to temporary semantic binding.
conditions: A column-level collation overrides table defaults. A column with its own explicit character-set or binary role requires its own resolved collation. A named table collation can determine the character set when the table charset is omitted. A table with its own charset option must specify a matching named charset. Duplicate, unresolved and incompatible collation or charset options must not be interpreted as utf8mb4_bin.
meaning: Both explicit and inherited stock binary collation resolve to the same completed native type and semantics. Keep physical reference identity, exact projected bytes, NULL, duplicates and padding behavior.
sql: Emit the same physical reference and native result operation regardless of the route by which the collation was resolved.
observations: Exact physical column collation, width and nullability
The same type at the same observed resolved position for direct and analyzed values
Case-sensitive padded equality, exact typed rows, column names and duplicate handling

finite.completeness: Recover physical source origin, projected expression role and filter from each directly constructed value, then observe the paired SQL analysis for each origin.

exploration.requiredForms: Vary origin, projection operands, qualifiers, literal values, ordered result headings and supported text filters.

evidence.Q02: Consume every fixed origin, position and filter combination plus seeded cases.
evidence.Q03: Check metadata and operator composition at the owning source.
evidence.Q04: Compare exact stored and projected values with actual physical definitions.
evidence.Q05: Tie raw evidence and declared selection logic to the staged PHP.
